findings.reason: the node's done-when must name the three tests Rule 2 retires and the §21 "requests_per_run and worker_slots are null, never guessed" text it supersedes, otherwise implementation proceeds against a suite the section believes is green and is not.
findings.text: §24 Rule 2 makes `_AdmissionLedger.snapshot` assume one request per run where it currently withholds, so `worker_slots` becomes numeric instead of null; three tests in the very file the section names pin the old contract (`test_two_live_runs_publish_null_even_while_congested` asserts `worker_slots is None`; `test_ratio_rounding_to_zero_withholds_both_derived_figures` asserts both figures withheld; `test_fresh_ledger_withholds_derived_figures_until_history_elapses` asserts the null-before-history rule from §21 "never guessed"), yet §24 claims "the existing router, lane and live-panel tests pass" and "Nothing is retired"

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §24 Rule 1 hides the whole headroom composition — the engine figure (usable published headroom, else the numeric `withheld.headroom` estimate), then the gate's `admission.headroom` — behind one function in imas_ambix/agent/lane.py used by both the router and live_panel, so no reader re-derives the rule.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the headroom selection is placed in imas_ambix/agent/lane.py, the module that already declares itself the lane-document schema owner (lane.py:665), and the worker-slot fallback stays inside its owner `_AdmissionLedger.snapshot` (router.py:343), so no shared mechanism is forked.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §24 states "One published field, worker_slots_basis, is added. Nothing is retired", but Rule 2 retires the null-when-thin worker-slot contract and inverts tests that pin it, and the section does not name them.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites and reuses the mechanisms it extends rather than adding a parallel subsystem: the router generation gate and its `_AdmissionLedger` (imas_ambix/agent/router.py:289), `availability_percent` and the lane-document schema it owns (imas_ambix/agent/lane.py:651), and `classify_reading`/`lane_block` (imas_ambix/agent/live_panel.py:479), each by file and mechanism.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the assumed-rate path of §24 Rule 2 reuses the `_AdmissionLedger` capacity formula (`capacity = floor(width / ratio)`, `worker_slots = max(0, capacity - live_runs)`) with ratio 1 rather than wrapping it, and the live_panel derivation branch is an extension of the pattern already justified at imas_ambix/agent/live_panel.py:475, so nothing is a wrapper over an extendable owner.
